description: This file contains C source code for handling TR-069/WMP protocol requests and responses, including parsing JSON payloads, forming responses, and freeing request/response structures. It appears to be a stub implementation used for unit testing.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_generic_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload to extract command and request details, and initializes request structures based on command type.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_request
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls wdmp_parse_generic_request with a default payload type.

methods.name: wdmp_form_response
methods.description: Creates a JSON response payload based on the response object, handling different request types.

methods.name: wdmp_free_req_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a request structure, including nested parameters.

methods.name: wdmp_free_res_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a response structure, including nested parameters and data.
